provenance: Original synthetic teaching contracts and probabilities; no observed prices, estimated defaults or current legal claims.

conventions.time: years after 1 January 2027; date zero is before all payouts
conventions.structural: one nonrecourse zero-coupon debt; default is asset value strictly below face; no other claims or interim payout
conventions.scheduled: first default occurs at an interval end before that date coupon; recovery of par replaces all remaining rights; delayed comparison pays the same recovery only at final maturity
conventions.continuous: constant deterministic short rate and measure-labeled intensities; immediate recovery of par, maturity-paid recovery and recovery of pre-default market value are different contracts
conventions.transition: annual row-stochastic P and Q on A,B,D; D is absorbing; recovery paid once on first entry into D before any maturity principal
conventions.joint: two nonrecourse notes settle at one year; stipulated risk-neutral investors make physical and pricing probabilities equal in this separate example only
conventions.liquidity: a supplied nonreplicable frictional valuation wedge relative to a credit benchmark; not a second executable price for identical freely replicable cash flows
